title: GuideWell Announces First Chief Health Equity Officer
主要内容: GuideWell Mutual Holding Corporation appointed Dr. Kelli Tice as its first Chief Health Equity Officer in January 2022. Tice, a family physician with a background in public health, will focus on advancing health equity and addressing social, health, and racial inequities in the communities served by GuideWell. She will also continue to lead the Equity Alliance, an initiative targeting systemic racism and health disparities for Black Americans. Tice joined GuideWell and Florida Blue in 2018 as Senior Medical Director of Medical Affairs and led Florida Blue's response to the COVID-19 pandemic, emphasizing public health education and community outreach. She has also spearheaded GuideWell's Health Equity pledge with 40 cross-sector health organizations and developed a health equity dashboard to analyze social determinants of health and barriers to care.
